Check Engine SEO 1.3.161

**Check Engine is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes) to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Three anonymous counts, once each.* The app now sends one count the first time it is opened, one the first time an audit finishes, and one the first time the free version reaches its limit and shows the unlock. Each is a single web request that carries only the event name, the app version and whether the computer is a Mac, Windows or Linux: no web address, no site you audit, no results, no licence key and no ID. It is sent once per copy and per event. An audit you run with "Keep it private: only contact this site" switched on sends no count when it finishes. You can turn all three off before you first open the app by setting `DOCKET_NO_COUNTS=1`, or by creating an empty file named `no-counts` in the `.docket` folder in your home folder. The full wording is on [the privacy page](https://checkengineseo.com/legal/privacy/).
- *The start screen and the About panel no longer say "No tracking".* They now say "No account · Your audits stay on this computer", which is still true and does not overstate it.
- Nothing else changed in how audits, reports or licences work. Your licence key, settings and past reports carry over as before.

99 checks across 13 areas.
